title: Cut and publish lore 0.11.0 paired with quest 0.11.0 (Constitution Article 3)
description: User instruction 2026-09-26 ("publish now"), given directly in the lore-cli session after the release question. Minor release carrying LCLI-595/596 (Constitution and Constants types), 597/609 (R8 managed-block render and Constitution auto-pin), 604/608 (ruling 28 managed scope), 606 (R11 check enforcement, behaviour change), 607 (sanitiser) and 599 (release notes). Procedure: docs/runbooks/release-publishing.md step 3. The release-prep commit bumps the version in 7 npm manifests, the optionalDependencies pins and .claude-plugin/plugin.json, regenerates bun.lock, refreshes the Ladybug digest baselines, regenerates the README version lines, and moves [Unreleased] to [0.10.0]. Then dev, promote, tag v0.10.0, the opum-marketplace handshake (LCLI-469), a publish:false Release run, the opum-cli-e2e qualification receipt, scripts/publish-release.sh, and a registry and clean-install verification recorded in lore-cli-release-truth.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The release-prep commit lands on main with every version-bearing file at 0.10.0 and bun install --frozen-lockfile, bun test and bun run lore check exit 0
v0.10.0 is tagged on the verified main commit and opum-marketplace is sent the tag object, commit and skills/ tree SHA
All seven packages are published at 0.10.0 from the qualified Release artifacts, and the registry read-back and a clean npx install are recorded in the release-truth record

implementationNotes: RE-TARGETED 0.10.0 -> 0.11.0, 2026-09-27. The user answered AskUserQuestion in this session with "Pair at 0.11.0"; separately, opum-agent ruled (bf4fd4b4, 00:36Z) that lore never publishes 0.10.0 and releases as 0.11.0 paired with quest 0.11.0 under the ratified Opum project constitution, Article 3 (opum-ai/opum-agent#988). Article 3 requires three things here. Clause 6: both publishers refuse unless the lore and quest versions match; mirrored with quest-cli version-parity.mjs (opum-ai/quest-cli#308). Clause 5: publish under the release-candidate dist-tag only, then move latest quest-first, then lore, only after the opum-cli-e2e pair receipt (receipts/pair/<v>.json) PASSes and on opum-agent go. The LCLI-469 marketplace handshake comes after latest moves. This commit bumps all version sites to 0.11.0. Ladybug canonicalExportSha256 was refreshed for 0.11.0 (only that field moved; the version-driven negative control was proven at the 0.10.0 bump on the same tree). The CHANGELOG is cut to [0.11.0] - 2026-09-27. The parity/rc/promote tooling is split to its own task because it touches scripts/ and release.yml (reviewer required).

TIER-3 APPROVAL, first-party, 2026-09-27: the user answered AskUserQuestion in this lore-cli session with "Approve both steps". (1) Stage all seven packages at 0.11.0 under the release-candidate dist-tag once the gates and the opum-cli-e2e receipt allow it. (2) Later move latest to 0.11.0, only after the opum-cli-e2e pair receipt PASSes and opum-agent gives the go, with quest moving first. This supersedes the earlier 0.10.0-to-latest approval, which covered a different action and was never exercised.

HANDOFF 2026-09-27 ~04:20Z, at a clean boundary (orchestrator asked to stop after staging; this session is renewed after the release). STATE, read by ref: lore-cli origin/main == bb225f1c (v0.11.0 ANNOTATED tag 1734cc96 peels to bb225f1c); origin/dev == 6fbdcb77 plus this handoff PR (tracker-only). npm: all seven @opum-ai/lore* packages have release-candidate=0.11.0 and latest=0.9.3 UNMOVED (npm view --prefer-online). Manual path, so no provenance attestation. Clean install of @opum-ai/lore@0.11.0 prints 0.11.0. REMAINING, in order, all already user-approved (tier 3, "Approve both steps"): (1) opum-cli-e2e pass-2 pair receipt receipts/pair/0.11.0.json on its MAIN (registry installs of both staged products); (2) quest-cli moves quest latest first; (3) on opum-agent go, run scripts/promote-latest.mjs --version 0.11.0 --dry-run, then --promote. It refuses unless all seven are release-candidate, quest latest == 0.11.0, the pair receipt verifies, and v0.11.0 peels to the receipt commit; it writes the prior-latest record first. (4) After latest moves: the README read-back, gh release create v0.11.0 from CHANGELOG [0.11.0], the LCLI-469 handshake to opum-marketplace (skills unchanged since v0.9.3, tree ce580cd1, so a no-op confirmation), the release-truth record (docs/reference/lore-cli-release-truth.md; manual publish, no provenance), then complete LCLI-611.
